newsitem.title: USA: Dow slips after rise above 7,300 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow slips after rise above 7,300 points.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks were lower Tuesday as profit-taking spoiled the Dow Jones industrial average's bid to close above the 7,300-point level for the first time.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow closed down 18.54 points at 7,274.21 following a brief rally to a high of 7,315.83. In the broader market, declining issues led advances 13-11 on active volume of 493 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
